selection: Among candidates inside the fixed price RMSE limit, minimize mean squared Greek RMSE divided by training-label RMS squared. If none pass, select minimum price RMSE and mark the gate failed.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation price MSE normalized by strike, unchanged from comparison.
replication: Retrain the full price-only pilot from each fresh seed before the selected weighted continuation. Include selection seed separately and report all three, with sample standard deviation. No retuning after replication.
